A '''hunting knife''' was a [[Knife/Legends|knife]] used to kill animals for food, shelter, or clothing. It was also used as a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]]. Some were small enough to be concealed in a [[Boot/Legends|boot]] or sleeve, while others were half a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] long. When not in use, it was often in a [[Sheath/Legends|sheath]].

==History==
Near the end of the [[Old Republic era]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] was attacked by a number of [[Orbalisk|strange crustaceans]] that dug through his armor and attached to his body. Bane tried to use his hunting knife which he kept in his boot to pry and carve them off his body, but to no avail. He discovered that the creatures were able to regenerate even the deep knife wounds he was inflicting upon himself in his attempts to be free of them. They eventually formed a symbiotic relationship.<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>

[[Pqweeduk]] carried a hunting knife while he explored various caves and jungles with his older brother [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]]. That particular knife had been given to Pqweeduk by his uncle [[Nok (Rodian)|Nok]] for his twelfth birthday.<ref name="A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>

A hunting knife was used in an attempted murder by [[Finn Darktrin]], an undercover agent working for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He used his hunting knife, which he kept in his sleeve, to stab [[Dusque Mistflier]], a woman who had fallen in love with him. Dusque survived the incident and joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after being rescued by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine]]''</ref>

[[Grif Grawley]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]], carried a hunting knife with him. It was half a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] long, and the blade was fashioned from diamond-hard [[Hull/Legends|hull]] metal. Grawley used this blade during what would prove to be a fatal encounter with [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] [[AD-43]] while on a mission to stop [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] from harnessing the power of the fabled [[Valley of the Jedi]].<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>
